selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What lesson did the traveler get from the Qur'an?
questions.answer: He learned about faith and Allah’s oneness.

questions.question: What does tawhid mean here?
questions.answer: That Allah is One and has no partner.

questions.question: How often are its verses read?
questions.answer: They are read all the time, every minute.

questions.question: What does the large number of readers tell us?
questions.answer: That the Qur'an is followed and honored by many.

questions.question: How long has its rule and guidance continued?
questions.answer: For more than fourteen centuries.

questions.question: For how many centuries has its shining moral rule continued?
questions.answer: More than fourteen centuries.

questions.question: What did the traveler understand about faith?
questions.answer: It is the most valuable thing a person can have.

questions.question: What does faith give that a short earthly home cannot give?
questions.answer: A forever home and kingdom.

questions.question: What does faith open for a person?
questions.answer: An eternal treasure of lasting happiness.

questions.question: What two big ideas are taught in this passage?
questions.answer: Belief in Allah and Allah’s oneness.

questions.question: What truth about Allah is at the center of this teaching?
questions.answer: Only Allah is truly God.

questions.question: Who reads the Qur'an besides people?
questions.answer: Angels and jinn.

questions.question: What is special about the way it is read?
questions.answer: It is read with deep respect.

questions.question: Why does the passage mention many surahs and verses agreeing together?
questions.answer: To show that the Qur'an gives strong proof, not a weak one.

questions.question: What fraction of the earth is mentioned?
questions.answer: About half.

questions.question: Does faith only give a small reward for a short time?
questions.answer: No. It gives something lasting and very great.

questions.question: Why is faith better than getting only something in this world?
questions.answer: Because faith gives blessings that last forever.

questions.question: What treasure does faith open?
questions.answer: A treasure of everlasting joy.

questions.question: In this passage, what does the traveler now know for sure?
questions.answer: That faith is very precious.

questions.question: What does the passage say about Allah besides His oneness?
questions.answer: That His existence is certain and necessary.

questions.question: What shows that the Qur'an is loved by many people?
questions.answer: So many people keep reading it with respect.

questions.question: What do the many readers do each minute?
questions.answer: They recite its verses.

questions.question: What parts of the Qur'an work together in giving witness?
questions.answer: Its chapters, verses, inner meanings, lights, results, and signs.

questions.question: Is the Qur'an’s authority described as only physical or also spiritual?
questions.answer: Also spiritual.
